hyperparameters.vectorizer: word 1-2 gram TF-IDF, L2-normalized, fit on TRAIN only
hyperparameters.tokenizer: lowercase [a-z0-9]+ — apostrophes EXCLUDED. Both corpora are Python dict reprs, so quote shape ('' , 'snippet' , id') was carrying the cross-corpus score as a format artifact: inspecting the weights showed '' alone at -1.07, which means the model had learned how the twins were built rather than what an injection says. Chosen from train/val inspection; the frozen AgentDojo attack holdout was never read in making this choice.
